recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖先以 SSC 對 CD15 圈出顆粒球，再看 FLAER 與 CD55/CD59：正常人顆粒球落在雙陽性象限（99.75%），而本例 98.60% 的顆粒球落在 FLAER 與 CD55/59 雙陰性象限，代表大型 PNH 克隆。
features: Two-column comparison of a normal control and the patient sample
Granulocytes gated on SSC versus CD15 (red population, high SSC, CD15 bright)
Normal control: 99.75% of granulocytes are FLAER-positive and CD55/CD59-positive
Patient: 98.60% of granulocytes are FLAER-negative and CD55/CD59-negative (GPI-anchor deficient)
Small residual 0.18% double-positive normal granulocytes in the patient; overall clone involves over 98% of granulocytes
describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood compares a normal control with the patient sample. Granulocytes are gated on side scatter versus CD15 and then assessed for FLAER binding and expression of the GPI-anchored proteins CD55 and CD59. In the normal control, nearly all granulocytes (99.75%) are FLAER and CD55/CD59 positive, whereas in the patient 98.60% of granulocytes lack both FLAER binding and CD55/CD59 expression. Findings demonstrate a large PNH clone involving more than 98% of granulocytes, consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria arising in the setting of aplastic anemia.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia with small PNH clone
ddx.vs: Many aplastic anemia patients have minor GPI-deficient populations (often <10%), whereas this clone replaces nearly all granulocytes, indicating a clinically significant PNH clone.
Isolated inherited deficiency affects a single antigen on all cells, whereas FLAER negativity together with loss of both CD55 and CD59 indicates a global GPI-anchor defect from PIGA mutation.

ddx.dx: Technical artifact from poor gating or reagent failure
ddx.vs: Artifact is excluded by the normal control run in parallel and by the residual small population of normal FLAER-positive granulocytes in the patient.
